## Hi, I'm Siera 👋

I came to data science from the desire to turn raw data into actionable insights to make the world a better place. What keeps me here is the beauty of storytelling with data visualizations and the ability to have an impact.

At Willamette my focus has been the intersection of environmental protection and data visualization. My [capstone](capstone.qmd) is where that comes together.

### Beyond the terminal

- 🌲 I enjoy spending time outdoors. Whether walking my dog or going on a hike I love spending time in the sun. 
- 📚 I am currently learning more about Supply Chain Data Analytics to reduce waste that negatively impacts businesses and the environment.
- 🎯 In two years, I want to continue to explore dashboard creation to create accessible insights for executives.
